building: 吳鳳科技大學 生有樓
scope: Original source/appearance summary and exact model/render artifact binding; no source photographs or plans are included. This is not manufacturing, test-print or publication approval.
basis: School-labeled 2014 aerial exterior; 2025-10 floor-plan topology crosscheck; original desktop-scale representative model.

appearance_findings.finding: Two low wings through 5F, smaller upper triangle for 6–9F, irregular low rear masses and open triangular court remain distinct.
The three-level portal beneath the 4F/5F crossing is open; rounded steps and conservative pillars are present.
Open-to-sky court, recessed gallery depths, lower court bottom, raised paths and projecting triangular platform remain visible. The ground/base is not a through-hole.
The two false large tail slots identified in v2 are closed by bounded connecting bodies, while the true courtyard remains open.

Four primary upper window bands; clearer paper-right exterior has entrance/main/tail groups and pale sills; more obscured left exterior is conservatively reduced. Courtyard galleries have a different rhythm/depth.

Separate central and pale sloping panels, exposed perimeter slopes, major lateral openings and a high segmentation gap remain readable. Bounded under-panel closure and localized collars do not turn the roof into a solid pyramid.
The two diagonal back faces remain neutral, low-detail and unmirrored; source uncertainty is explicit.

No neighboring round-court building, white high-rise or full linking bridges are added. All seven whole-object views include the full model/base with margins; the two perspective views intentionally frame local details.

limitations: No reliable real-world dimensions, total height, floor heights or 1:N scale were obtained; all output millimetres are model dimensions or estimates.

2014 is the school video label, not an independently proven per-frame capture date. The 2025 plans are not same-year as-built elevations. This is neither a precise 2001 completion reconstruction nor a 2026-current-condition model.

Two incompletely observed diagonal back elevations use neutral low-detail closures; blank surfaces are not claims that the actual building has no windows. No front-window template is mirrored onto them.
Partial 9/10F auditorium roof volume is not a complete tenth standard floor. The lower wings do not continue to nine storeys.
Roof slopes, exact segmentation sizes, hidden interiors and joints, floor heights, window counts, thin-member thicknesses and courtyard levels are simplified estimates.

Central roof closure is confined to the two existing front/central panel projections. Local rounded collars and ridge support are unverified print-construction estimates, not source-proven actual joints.
View identifiers east/west/north/south are interface/local-coordinate labels, not verified geographic directions.

Appearance approval does not constitute manufacturing, slicer, physical-test-print, general privacy, licensing or publication approval. Keep the separate geometry/print limitations and publication gate.
